summary: First E2E iteration for KasirKu POS. Backend pytest suite: 21/21 passing (auth, store, products, cashiers, transactions with stock decrement & profit, reports summary, multi-tenant isolation, file upload/download via query token). Frontend Playwright: login->dashboard->tutup-toko WA deeplink->products CRUD->POS full flow (search, add, cart, cash pay, success modal) all pass. WA URL correctly constructed with wa.me/<digits>?text=<encoded>.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning in console for cart, pay, qty, product form, success modals)
Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits width(-1)/height(-1) warning on initial render (renders correctly after layout)

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to Radix Dialog usages in POS.jsx, Products.jsx, Cashiers.jsx, History.jsx to silence a11y warnings.
(Optional) On Dashboard chart, wrap ResponsiveContainer parent with explicit min-height to avoid initial (-1,-1) warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/store PUT uses user['id'] as owner_id — correctly gated by require_owner, good.

Transactions: stock decrement is not atomic (findOne + updateOne) — race condition possible under concurrent sales of same product from multiple cashiers. Consider $inc with negative qty in single update.
Transactions: no stock check before decrement — allows negative stock. Add validation if business requires.

Files endpoint: JWT decoded but no owner check against file record — any authenticated user (incl cashiers of other tenants) can download any file if they know storage_path. Enforce owner_id match on rec['owner_id'] against decoded token 'owner_id'.
server.py exceeds ~510 lines — still manageable but split by domain (auth/products/txn/reports) recommended as it grows.
Cashier login route does not distinguish tenant — fine since cashier.owner_id is stored in JWT.
get_current_user prefers cookie over Authorization header — correct.
CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with credentials — works but consider restricting to FRONTEND_URL in production.
